long_description:
Join Kate on Saturday October 17th from 3:00-4:00pm for Happy Hour at Healium Hot Yoga Bay View in collaboration with Nonfiction Natural Wines! 

Ease into your Saturday evening with an hour of mildly heated vinyasa flow (so you don’t get too sweaty!) at Healium Hot Yoga-Bay View and then walk across the street to Nonfiction Natural Wines’ beautiful wine bar for a glass of wine and specialty snacks! 

Purchase includes yoga, one glass of wine and snacks. 

$35 / Person 

You may also like the following events from Healium Hot Yoga:Next Thursday, 22nd October, 06:00 pm, Nervous System Reset in MilwaukeeNext Saturday, 24th October, 09:00 am, Bandha Immersion Weekend in MilwaukeeNext month, 8th November, 09:00 am, Ayurvedic Meditation Immersion: Training the Mind for Clarity in MilwaukeeAlso check out other Health & Wellness events in Milwaukee.
